items.title: Google Jules AI coding agent winding down, learnings moving to Antigravity
facts: Jules will wind down on December 31, 2026.
Users have until November 11, 2026 to continue finishing up sessions.
After November 11, 2026, Jules will be turned to read-only until the end of the year.

items.title: Google Antigravity launches Plugin Marketplace for discovering and installing plugins
facts: Today, we are launching the Plugin Marketplace in Antigravity, a centralized directory for discovering and installing third-party and Google-built plugins across the Antigravity App and the Antigravity CLI.
The Plugin Marketplace packages these primitives into verified, shareable bundles that you can browse by category and install in a click.
The Plugin Marketplace in Antigravity is rolling out today across the Antigravity App and the Antigravity CLI.

items.title: OpenAI Codex CLI 0.166.0 adds keyboard transcript controls and GPT-6.1 Terra
facts: Added keyboard-driven transcript selection with word, line, and page motions, integrated search, and configurable shortcuts.
Added GPT-6.1 Terra to the bundled, Vertex AI, and Amazon Bedrock model catalogs.
Added codex doctor --network-only for focused configuration, connectivity, and WebSocket diagnostics.

items.title: GitHub Copilot Fusion generally available for multi-model orchestration
facts: GitHub Copilot Fusion is generally available.
Instead of picking a model for each task, choose Copilot Fusion and let Copilot intelligently route and orchestrate which models it uses for you.
In the Artificial Analysis Coding Agent Index, Copilot Fusion Max scored 60, within two points of Claude Code with Opus 5.5 Max.

items.title: GitHub Agentic Workflows reaches general availability
facts: GitHub Agentic Workflows, an open source project from GitHub Next, is now generally available.
With agentic workflows, you can automate reasoning-based tasks like issue triage, CI failure analysis, documentation updates, and test writing by using coding agents inside GitHub Actions.
Define your automation in natural language Markdown files, and GitHub Agentic Workflows compiles them into standard Actions YAML.

items.title: Hidden disclaimer hints at shared usage limits for ChatGPT and Codex starting December
facts: A new hidden checkout disclaimer says: Starting in December, plan usage will have a shared limit across all of ChatGPT and Codex.

items.title: OpenCode releases v2.2.1 and v2.2.2 with goal tracking and image generation
facts: Run /goal <objective> in the TUI or Desktop to let the session continue until a reviewer confirms the objective is met.
Enable experimental.image_generate to let agents create or edit images with the new image_generate tool.
